tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: There is a long pending tax issue with Maharashtra State Sales Tax Department related to Sales Tax on sale of ships under Cost plus contracts. MDL filed an appeal with Maharashtra Sales Tax Tribunal (MSTT) under the repealed Bombay Sales Tax Act. The tax demands aggregate to Rs.99,620.51 Lakhs approx., in respect of the years 1980-81 to 1981-82 and 1992-93 to 2004-05. The customer has reimbursed total Part Payment made by MDL towards demand. The Maharashtra Sales Tax Appellate Tribunal has granted a permanent stay on the recovery proceedings on 19 Jul 2010 till final disposal of the appeals.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Sales Tax (Assessment)38 E-ward, Unit-I, Bombay
tax_litigation.status: In this regard, judgement for F.Y. 1980-81, 1981-82 & 1992-93 has been received. The year wise order details are as under; a) FY 1980-81:- MSTT has levied tax of Rs 22.17 Lakhs against the disputed amount of Rs 397.57 Lakhs which has been applied for payment of Rs 3.84 Lakhs under Amnesty Scheme 2025. However, aggrieved by the order, Revenue Department has filed rectification & reference appeal against the said order. b)FY 1981-82:- MSTT has levied tax of Rs 23.87 Lakhs against the disputed amount of Rs 479.74 Lakhs which has been settled by payment Rs 6.33 Lakhs under Amnesty Scheme 2025. c) FY 1992-93:- MSTT has levied tax of Rs 410.28 Lakhs against the disputed amount of Rs 2128.01 Lakhs.Upfront mistake was noticed in order and hence MDL has filed rectification application against the said order. Hence the revised disputed amount in MSTT stand to Rs 99,140.77 Lakhs.

MDL has filed an appeal with CESTAT seeking refund of excess service tax paid. The case is yet to come for hearing.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Service Tax, Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: No change and hence the status is same as previous quarter disclosure.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Total Disputed amount of Rs. 7563 Lakhs. The subject appeal has been filed by the Commissioner of Sales Tax against the order dated 27.04.2018 passed by the Second Bench of Maharashtra Sales Tax Tribunal in favour of MDL in respect of tax issues pertaining to medium refit cum upgradation of INS Shalki & INS Shankul. MDL's contention in respect of medium refit-cum-upgradation contract of INS Shalki & Shankul is that it is a sale in the course of import and cannot be subjected to tax. In order to avoid payment of any interest and penalty MDL has paid tax under composition @ 8% amounting to Rs. 7563 Lakhs. The Financial claim / impact in the appeal would be Rs. 7563 Lakhs The Appeal has been admitted by the Bombay High Court vide its order dated 21.02.2019. The Appeal is yet to be listed for hearing.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Bombay High Court, MVAX/31/2018 by Additional Commissioner of Sales Tax
tax_litigation.status: No change and hence the status is same as previous quarter disclosure.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Total Disputed amount of Rs. 4713.08 Lakhs. Service Tax Authorities raised a demand in respect of repairs and maintenance services for ships/submarines rendered by MDL during 2001-2004 on the ground that these fall under the head “Port Services”. MDL filed an Appeal before Commissioner (Appeals) and thereafter before CESTAT. CESTAT vide order dtd.21.04.2008 set aside the demand made by Service Tax Authority. Service Tax Authority have filed this present Appeal before the Bombay High Court against the CESTAT’s order. MDL has filed Affidavit in Reply on 24.12.2024 and the matter yet to listed further.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Bombay High Court, CEXA/226/2008 by The Commissioner of Service tax
tax_litigation.status: No change and hence the status is same as previous quarter disclosure.

operating_notes.text: Acquired a 51% controlling stake in Colombo Dockyard PLC during the period.
Secured a 51% controlling stake in Colombo Dockyard PLC for ₹236.95 Cr in FY26.
Order book of ₹20,535 Cr as of March 31, 2026, includes ₹8,257 Cr for P17A Stealth Frigates.
Signed a teaming agreement with Swan Defence for Landing Platform Docks.
President of India held 32,76,18,501 shares with zero encumbrance as of March 31, 2026.
Indigenous content increased to 75% in P17A frigates
₹1,006 mn invested in concept & design for future bids in FY26
Board approved ₹1,250 Cr SBLC facility with SBI for subsidiary Colombo Dockyard PLC.
Signed MoU with National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park Andhra Pradesh for a greenfield shipbuilding cluster at Dugarajapatnam with an envisaged investment of ₹15,000 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,850.39 Cr (+21.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹679.18 Cr.
Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd’s Board, led by Lalatendu Acharya, recommended a final dividend of ₹4.62 per equity share (₹5 face value) for FY2026.
Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders reported FY26 revenue of ₹12,840 Cr and acquired a 51% stake in Colombo Dockyard PLC for ₹236.95 Cr.
Mazagon Dock updated its board on May 12, 2026, regarding exchange notices for non-compliance with independent director norms.
Ministry of Defence (acting for President of India) disclosed holding 32,761,8501 shares of ₹5 each in Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrance.
Mazagon Dock disclosed that the President of India's 32.76 crore shares remained unencumbered for FY26.
Mazagon Dock provided investor presentation highlighting Q1FY27 results, strong order book, and diversification into oil & gas sector
Board of Directors declared interim dividend of Rs.5 per equity share, record date 3 November 2026, payment by 26 November 2026.
Mazagon Dock approved a ₹1,250 crore Standby Letter of Credit facility with State Bank of India for its subsidiary Colombo Dockyard PLC on October 27, 2026.
Mazagon Dock reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹5,555 Cr and an order book of ₹16,443 Cr as of 30 September 2026.

watchlist.text: Review by Comptroller and Auditor General of India (C&AG)
Appointment of independent directors by the Ministry of Defence

status_history.evidence: Q2FY27 investor presentation discloses order book figures as of 30 September 2026.
